$comment: The one source of the RedScope Technologies style. The palette is variations of dark night with gray, white, red and crimson (BRAINSTORM Q2); the schemes only name palette shades. scripts/build.py turns it into CSS variables; tests/check.py checks contrast. Night 900 and red 600 were sampled from the logo.

font.$comment: Q4: terminal-like, from the system's own fonts (nothing to load). text is the pages' font, mono the code's.
font.text: ui-monospace, "Ubuntu Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Liberation Mono", "Noto Sans Mono", Menlo, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "Courier New", monospace
font.mono: ui-monospace, "Ubuntu Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Liberation Mono", "Noto Sans Mono", Menlo, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "Courier New", monospace

contrast.$comment: Pairs that must reach WCAG AA (4.5:1) in both schemes; checked by tests/check.py.
